propositions: Comment blocks across six subsystem agents (439 files) are triaged and relocated to taxonomy destinations: history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, contracts to schema, keeping only proximate just-in-time context inline.

Self-referential prose explaining the 800-LOC comment budget occupies 28+ sites in reconciler and elsewhere, with the largest recovery headrooms at runtime hotspots (runner.py 3→48 lines, dispatch_one.py 14→57 lines).
Three files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) retain most comments because they document replay-compat and security invariants that are load-bearing and cannot be safely relocated.
Verified-stale comments are corrected in place (not deleted) where they document live invariants; six sites incorrectly document deterministic floors as P1-P9 while DET_CHECKS runs P1-P11.

Each shard produces a do_not_move list of load-bearing blocks (anti-refactor warnings, external-API facts, pragmas, test-introspected docstrings) recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing to prevent future re-flagging.

Net recovery across six shards is ~85 comment/docstring lines (output measured post-triage, not a target), with most prose moved verbatim to new ADRs 0062-0069 rather than deleted, and all changes verified CI-passing with no behaviour change.
